files.content:
# Proposal

<!-- pdac-scope: none reason="Issue #196 explicitly classifies this single-word fixture documentation correction as having no new product intent; no product behavior or canonical artifact changes." -->

## Why

Issue #196 requests correction of a typo in the controlled unattended-delivery fixture as acceptance work for #185 and PR #190. The correction must not change fixture behavior.

## What Changes

- Replace only `acceptence` with `acceptance` in `src/tests/fixtures/unattended/README.md`, producing `controlled acceptance fixture`.
- Preserve every other fixture byte, including the boundary-description paragraph, eligibility source and tests.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities

None.

### Modified Capabilities

None. No spec-level behavior changes; `.openspec.yaml` contains `skip_specs: true`. The accepted `openspec/specs/` inventory contains only `.gitkeep`.

## Impact

One documentation word; no API, runtime, data, dependency, product-model or architecture changes. Provider planning artifacts remain within this change root. Existing FF fixture-only policy, required repository checks and independent planning/candidate reviews remain unchanged; this proposal grants no implementation, merge, release or deployment permission. Integration target: `main`.

# Design

<!-- pdac-scope: none reason="The owner-defined documentation-only correction in issue #196 requires no product-semantic or architecture decision." -->

## Context

See proposal.md for motivation. The typo is on README line 3. `eligibility.mjs` already uses `>= 2`; existing regression tests import it directly and do not consume README text.

## Goals / Non-Goals

**Goal:** Keep the implementation diff limited to the exact requested word replacement.

**Non-goals:** Reconcile the historical boundary-defect wording, change code or tests, modify delivery policy, or alter product and architecture authorities. Interfaces and stored data are unaffected.

## Decisions

Use a literal word replacement, not paragraph rewriting or Markdown reformatting, to preserve all other bytes. Keep existing tests unchanged rather than adding a test for prose; exact text/byte comparison verifies the correction, while configured checks verify repository compatibility. Use the no-spec marker rather than manufacturing a behavioral requirement.

## Risks / Trade-offs

- Accidental cleanup beyond scope → compare the fixture against the authorized source, allowing only the requested replacement.
- Historical wording remains imperfect → leave it intact as explicitly required.

## Verification and Definition of Done

The corrected phrase is present; the README equals its original bytes with only `acceptence` replaced by `acceptance`; every other fixture file is unchanged. All configured commands in tasks.md must pass later, and independent planning review precedes implementation while independent candidate review follows verification. No new tests or visual evidence are needed because runtime and UI are unchanged. The trusted host materializes and validates these provider artifacts.

## Migration Plan

No migration or deployment is needed. Integration targets `main` only through the existing authorized route. Roll back the fixture correction by reverting its isolated word replacement; release and deployment remain separate.

# Tasks

<!-- pdac-scope: none reason="These tasks implement and verify only the documentation correction explicitly defined by the owner in issue #196, without changing product behavior." -->

## 1. Fixture documentation correction

- [ ] 1.1 After the existing independent planning review passes and the host authorizes implementation, replace only `acceptence` with `acceptance` in `src/tests/fixtures/unattended/README.md`; verify `controlled acceptance fixture` is present, the README bytes equal the authorized original with only that replacement, and all other fixture files are byte-identical. Confirm the implementation diff touches no source, tests, policy or workflows; any provider artifacts remain within `openspec/changes/issue-196-proposal/`.
- [ ] 1.2 Verify the candidate using the configured commands in order: `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, `env GITHUB_ACTIONS=true PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium npm run verify`, and `node --test src/tests/fixtures/unattended/regression.test.mjs`; retain successful results for independent candidate review without weakening required checks.

## Workflow follow-up

- Retain independent candidate review and trusted-host authorization checks before integration into `main` under the existing fixture-only FF policy; this plan does not grant merge permission.
- Archive only through the provider workflow after applicable reviews and checks; release and deployment remain separately authorized.
